claims.claim: Planet reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $116.1M, up 58% year over year, 98% recurring ACV, backlog of about $814.9M and $865.4M cash/cash equivalents/short-term investments.

factors.name: earth-intelligence demand
factors.basis: record revenue, recurring contract mix and backlog support expanding demand

risks.risk: Defense/intelligence demand can be program- and budget-sensitive; quarter-to-quarter satellite-services timing can be uneven.

causalEdges.mechanism: persistent imaging and sovereign capacity contracts convert security demand into recurring data/service revenue
causalEdges.falsifier: backlog conversion slows materially or major sovereign programs are not renewed

unknowns.unknown: Primary-hosted Planet IR copy was not retrieved in this run; Alpha should corroborate the syndicated company release against SEC/IR primary material.

claims.claim: Q2 FY2027 adjusted EBITDA profit was $13.9M and year-to-date adjusted free cash flow was $28.8M, while revenue reached $116.1M; execution improved materially versus the prior-year quarter.

factors.name: execution and operating leverage
factors.basis: record growth accompanied by positive adjusted EBITDA and free-cash-flow measures

risks.risk: Planet still reported a GAAP net loss and used an ATM program during the quarter, so dilution and GAAP profitability remain execution considerations.

causalEdges.mechanism: higher recurring revenue can spread fixed constellation/platform costs
causalEdges.falsifier: cash generation reverses or margins deteriorate as growth continues

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation conclusion is made; primary-source corroboration remains required.
